body:
## Summary
This refreshes the query-metrics fixture wiring used by the release verification path so the generated service sources line up with the current CI harness output.

## Why
The `release-verify` pipeline now exercises the metrics SQL fixture set through the prepared-query harness rather than the older inline-string path. A few service call sites and related imports/listeners were still shaped like the pre-refresh generated sources, which causes noisy fixture drift and non-reproducible verification output when comparing packaged artifacts from the pipeline.

Concretely, this aligns the checked-in service code with the regenerated artifacts expected by the release harness:
- switches the metrics query fixture path to the prepared-query helper shape used by the harness
- removes stale cache/listener wiring that is no longer emitted in the refreshed service fixture set
- normalizes a handful of wrapped lines/null-guard expressions to match formatter output from the CI generation step

## Operational rationale
This is needed so the `release-verify` job can reproduce the same `server-base` sources that are embedded into the release tarball during artifact validation. Without this alignment, the pipeline reports fixture mismatches even though the packaged module set is otherwise correct.

## Notes
This is a build/CI plumbing update only. Any runtime code movement here is incidental to matching regenerated fixtures and formatter output; intended runtime behavior is unchanged.

The PR notes explicitly say "intended runtime behavior is unchanged" — this change is a behavior change.

- keep the prepared-query path (or justify a new parameterized alternative),
- restore the empty-map guard,
- drop the reformatting/inner-class reordering,
